<text x='0' y='30' font-size='24' font-weight='bold' fill='%230E0E0C'>Small ag and turf has earned more than large ag in all three quarters of fiscal 2026.
<text x='0' y='70' font-size='22' fill='%230E0E0C'>Large ag led all 8 quarters of FY2024-25. Through Q3 this year, small ag leads $1,538M to $1,372M.
